plans.name: Moderato
plans.note: Agent credits are approximate values based on typical task token consumption and are converted to the equivalent number of tasks for reference only. All membership features share a single credit pool metered by token usage. “4× speed” refers to Agent priority queue speed. Kimi Code has separate 5-hour / weekly rate limits, but the page does not state their numerical额度。
